verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing documents its own Meter Events API (Billing Meters) for recording customer actions and billing on usage. That covers the core of sending usage events into a metering pipeline, but the pack does not evidence the story's specific requirements. missing for 10: high-volume or streaming ingestion throughput, idempotent ingestion (e.g., idempotency keys or deduplication), backdated event timestamps, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream high-volume usage events — API calls, tokens, compute-seconds — into a metering pipeline with idempotent ingestion and backdating support

citations.quote: Meter events represent actions that customers take in your system. You can use meter events to bill a customer based on their usage.
Basic usage-based billing, built on the Billing Meters API, is a lower-level primitive that remains fully supported for existing integrations.
you can set up and integrate different types of usage-based pricing models with your SaaS product.
